name: web-typography-panel-with-periwinkle-block-and-model-trio
title: Typography style page with periwinkle block, navy quote and three-model banner
whatItIs: A white page with an uppercase statement, then a two-part block: a periwinkle panel with 'TYPOGRAPHY' and huge white 'USED FOR BOLD HEADLINES & VISUAL HIERARCHY', and a navy panel with a quote. Below is a tinted photo trio of three models in blue hoodies with a large white overlaid headline 'YOUR STYLE, OUR SIGNATURE'.
whatItMeans: Confident and minimal; the type does the talking, tinted photos keep it cohesive.
techniques: Set the type rule as a real headline example instead of a specimen.
Split a wide block into a light periwinkle and a deep navy half.
Tint a row of photos with a blue overlay so headline text reads across all.
Keep all text in one grotesque family.
bestFor: Systems that show rules by example

vocabulary.definition: Showing a typeface within a real headline.
A panel divided in two colours.
A long sentence set in uppercase.
